scripts.build: npm ci --prefix admin && npm run build --prefix admin
scripts.check: node --check worker/src/index.js && node --check worker/src/auth.js && node --check worker/src/locations.js && node --check worker/src/batches.js && node --check worker/src/qrs.js && node --check worker/src/qr-render.js && node --check worker/src/activation.js && node --check worker/src/cloudflare-usage.js && node --check scripts/deploy-template.mjs && node --check scripts/check-runtime-secrets.mjs && node --check scripts/provision-runtime-secrets.mjs

SETUP_TOKEN.description: Required: generate a random secret (32+ characters), remember it privately, then enter it once on the administrator initialization page. Do not use the example value.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required: a different cryptographically random secret (32+ characters). Preserve its value across updates; never use the example value.

ACTIVATION_SECRET.description: Required: another distinct cryptographically random secret (32+ characters). Preserve across updates so existing activation codes remain valid.
